Problem Statement:
You are given with a sequence of n words to manipulate.If in a sequence,if two same words come together then they will destroy each other.After the complete execution print the length of string obtained. 
Input Description:
An integer ‘n’ denoting length of string,Next line contains string. 
Output Description:
Print the length of string obtained 
Explanation:
First you will remove aa,string becomes abc abc and then you will remove abc 
Sample Input:
4
abc aa aa abc 
Sample Output:
0
